title: Shadow runner for zero-delta upgrade validation
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Build a 'shadow-runner' orchestration that mirrors live inference traffic to a candidate runtime/model variant without affecting production responses. The goal is to detect functional regressions, perf regressions, and resource anomalies that only appear under real traffic shapes, while keeping the candidate path isolated (no writes, isolated KV cache, throttled tokens). This ticket implements the core runner, a result comparator with configurable tolerance budgets, and integration into the release gating pipeline.

Scope:
- Mirror sampled request types (chat, streaming, embeddings, rerank) for up to 72 hours per release candidate.
- Run deterministic output comparators (token-level hash, normalized JSON diff for structured outputs).
- Collect perf signals (p50/p95 latency, token/sec, GPU memory growth) and resource telemetry.
- Produce a single preflight report and gate decision (pass/warn/fail) with rationale and linkable evidence.

Non-goals:
- Not replacing canary traffic routing or rollout automation; this is validation-only (no traffic cutover).
- Not performing long-term model quality evaluation (that remains in eval-suite pipelines).
acceptance_criteria: Shadow-runner can mirror at least 3 traffic classes (chat, embeddings, rerank) without impacting prod latency < 1%
Comparator supports token-hash and structured-field diffs with configurable tolerances per route
Perf regression gate triggers if p95 latency delta > 10% or token throughput drop > 5% compared to baseline
Resource anomaly detector flags >10% GPU memory growth or sustained >15% higher GPU utilization
Generated preflight report includes links to raw traces, sample diffs, and the gate verdict and is consumable by release-orchestrator
End-to-end integration test exists in CI that simulates mirrored traffic and exercises comparator thresholds
tasks: Design shadow-runner architecture and interactions with proxy and runtime (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RE/Shadow+Runner+Design)
Implement request mirroring adapter in ingress proxy (configurable sample rates per route)
Add isolated execution flags in runtime to ensure no side-effects (disable writes, separate KV cache)
Build comparator library (token-hash, normalized JSON diff, semantic similarity hooks for embeddings)
Implement perf signal aggregator and delta calculator using existing telemetry (Prometheus + tracing)
Wire preflight report generator and integrate with release-orchestrator webhook
Create CI smoke test that runs fake traffic for chat+embed and validates comparator and gate output
Document runbook for interpreting reports and recommended rollback thresholds
comments: 2026-02-22: Initial scoping review with Product and SRE. Decided to keep shadow-runner read-only and to rate-limit mirrored traffic to avoid cost surprises. - Maya
2026-02-28: Design doc posted; we picked token-hash + JSON normalize as primary comparator to reduce noise from non-deterministic tokens. Need follow-up on embeddings similarity threshold. - Diego
2026-03-03: SRE asked for explicit resource isolation requirement: candidate runs must use a separate GPU pool or cgroups limits to prevent evicting production work. Added to tasks. - Diego

2026-03-07: Engineering review: comparator false positives on streaming partial tokens observed in prototype. Temporary fix: compare only final tokens after end-of-stream unless structured streaming is marked stable. Long-term: add per-route comparator plugins. - Lina (review)
2026-03-10: Perf gate thresholds tuned after 24h pilot: p95 delta threshold set to 10% for general releases, 5% for LTS channel. Documented threshold rationale and added labels. - Diego
2026-03-12: Security review required for mirrored data handling (PII risk). Marked security_review_required=true and added requirement to purge mirrored payloads after 7 days. - Maya
